mapper.select: SELECT id AS userId, unit_id AS unitId, display_name AS userName, authorization_version AS authorizationVersion FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{userId} AND status='ENABLED'
SELECT FROM sys_unit ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM sys_unit ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM intel_topic WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM intel_receipt r JOIN intel_send s ON s.id=r.send_id WHERE s.topic_id=#{topicId} AND r.to_unit_id=#{unitId}
mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.signed_at FROM intel_receipt r JOIN intel_send s ON s.id=r.send_id WHERE s.topic_id=t.id AND r.to_unit_id=#{unitId}

WHERE t.source_unit_id=#{unitId} EXISTS () AND t.status=#{status} AND EXISTS ( AND r.signed_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS ( AND r.signed_at IS NULL) AND (t.title LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR t.topic_no LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.topic_no AS topicNo, t.title, t.status, t.source_unit_name AS sourceUnitName, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.published_at AS publishedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM intel_receipt r JOIN intel_send s ON s.id=r.send_id WHERE s.topic_id=t.id AND r.to_unit_id=#{unitId} AND r.signed_at IS NULL) AS pendingReceiptCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM intel_receipt r JOIN intel_send s ON s.id=r.send_id WHERE s.topic_id=t.id AND r.to_unit_id=#{unitId}) AS myReceiptCount FROM intel_topic t ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT s.unit_id AS unitId,u.unit_code AS unitCode FROM intel_scope_unit s JOIN sys_unit u ON u.id=s.unit_id WHERE s.topic_id=#{topicId} ORDER BY s.unit_id
SELECT s.unit_id AS unitId,u.unit_code AS unitCode FROM intel_draft_target s JOIN sys_unit u ON u.id=s.unit_id WHERE s.topic_id=#{topicId} ORDER BY s.unit_id

SELECT r.id,r.send_id AS sendId,s.topic_id AS topicId,s.parent_receipt_id AS parentReceiptId, s.from_unit_id AS fromUnitId,s.from_unit_name AS fromUnitName,s.sender_name AS senderName,s.note,s.sent_at AS sentAt, r.to_unit_id AS toUnitId,r.to_unit_name AS toUnitName,r.signed_by_name AS signedByName,r.signed_at AS signedAt FROM intel_receipt r JOIN intel_send s ON s.id=r.send_id WHERE s.topic_id=#{topicId} ORDER BY r.id

SELECT f.id,f.receipt_id AS receiptId,f.body,f.unit_name AS unitName,f.user_name AS userName,f.created_at AS createdAt FROM intel_feedback f JOIN intel_receipt r ON r.id=f.receipt_id JOIN intel_send s ON s.id=r.send_id WHERE s.topic_id=#{topicId} ORDER BY f.id
SELECT id,kind,body,unit_name AS unitName,user_name AS userName,created_at AS createdAt FROM intel_supplement WHERE topic_id=#{topicId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE intel_topic SET title=#{title},body=#{body},draft_note=#{note},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT' AND version=#{version}
UPDATE intel_scope_unit s JOIN sys_unit u ON u.id=s.unit_id SET s.unit_name=u.unit_name WHERE s.topic_id=#{id}
UPDATE intel_topic SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT'
UPDATE intel_receipt SET signed_by_user_id=#{actor.userId},signed_by_name=#{actor.userName},signed_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND signed_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO intel_number_counter (business_date,last_number) VALUES (#{day},0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE business_date=business_date
mapper.select: SELECT last_number+1 FROM intel_number_counter WHERE business_date=#{day} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE intel_number_counter SET last_number=last_number+1 WHERE business_date=#{day}

mapper.update: UPDATE intel_command SET topic_id=#{id} WHERE actor_unit_id=#{unitId} AND action_code=#{action} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
